integrity: The displayed exact formula and universal claims have a complete analytic proof. Exact-rational finite checks are independently reproducible in verify.py but are not infinite proofs. Historical priority has not received independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted Cartesian products of two complete graphs, unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian and operator norm on all bounded node data; no result for general products, edge weights, normalized Laplacians or the mean-zero input unit ball. Generic Cartesian Green formulas are established earlier; the priority claim is limited to the sharp endpoint phase, exact plateau and associated scaling.
title: Exact Poisson amplification and a quadratic saturation threshold on rook graphs
